pin.headline: Weeknight Dinners, Done in One Pot
pin.sub: Pressure · Slow cook · Rice · Yogurt · Steam

scenes.line: Pot roast on a Tuesday night? Under pressure, it stops being a weekend-only dinner.
Meet the Instant Pot Duo Plus. Nine cooking jobs in one six-quart pot, and up to seventy percent faster than slow cooking.
Made for busy families of up to six. Pressure cook, slow cook, rice, steam and even homemade yogurt.

scenes.title: PRO TIP
scenes.note: Pressure needs liquid. Keep hands clear when venting.
scenes.line: Pro tip: always add some liquid, flick the easy-release switch to vent, and use delay start so dinner is ready when you walk in.
It's pick number one hundred twenty-eight. Find the link on our channel, under Video Picks.
